info.name: MediStock API
info.description:
Covers Auth, Profile, Medicines, Suppliers, Purchases, Sales, Stock Movements, Notifications, Reports, and Admin/User Management, with positive AND negative cases for every RBAC boundary and stock-integrity guarantee this pass fixed or added. See postman/README.md for how to run this.

IMPORTANT: some requests are ORDER-DEPENDENT within their folder (e.g. Register before Login, Create medicine before Update/Delete) because they capture ids/tokens into environment variables for later requests. Run each folder top-to-bottom, or use Postman's Collection Runner against the whole collection in order.

request.description: OWNERSHIP/IDOR TEST: a Supplier login must not be able to browse the full supplier directory (SUPPLIER is not in this endpoint's allowed roles) — it can only see its own data via GET /dashboard/supplier.
Ownership is derived entirely from the JWT server-side — there is no supplierId in this URL to tamper with, which is what prevents Supplier A from ever requesting Supplier B's data.
